rules.unit: SWE episode row / terminal episode (its two trained turns) / retention row; a p1_pools drop (task text) removes every unit of the task, a p2_rows drop (rendered row) removes the row's unit
rules.replacement: SWE only: a spare pool row (rendered for the other cap, fits this cap) of the same quota part and size stratum, else the same part (borrowed); one row per instance; <= 5 rows per repository
rules.no_spares: terminal (every admissible TermGrade episode is already in the pool) and retention (the replay reserve is stage-2 data): drops are shortfalls
